properties.otherAdvice:
Changed traffic conditions for the Coffs Harbour bypass will be in place from Monday 17 to Saturday 22 February, weather permitting.

  • Lane closures with contraflow traffic arrangements will be in place on the Pacific Highway northbound and southbound carriageways between James Small Drive (south) and Charlesworth Bay Road on Monday between 7pm and 6am
  • Lane closures will also be in place on the northbound and southbound Pacific Highway carriageways between James Small Drive (north) and south of the Luke Bowen pedestrian bridge on Thursday between 6pm and 7am
  • Single lane closures will be in place on the northbound and southbound carriageways of the Pacific Highway between Sawtell Interchange and Englands Road/Stadium Drive

For the safety of cyclists and workers, the project will temporarily close the Pacific Highway southbound shoulder between James Small Drive north and south. From Tuesday, cyclists are advised to use James Small Drive to ride south. This temporary detour will be in place until early 2026.

A temporary speed of 60km/h will remain in place through the project work zone.
